meta.move: Skill: cites procedure 4.4 correctly after owning the call
meta.expect: Says 4.4 meets her fallback demand, flatly, wants it in writing; does NOT move to the last position on 4.4 alone; debrief Where she ended says whether that is the fair outcome

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have until 4:40, so let's start with who decided on the zero, and whether anyone spoke to Owen before it went in.
Before anything: I entered the zero before calling you. That broke procedure 4.2, and I'm sorry.
Okay. Procedure 4.2, in your own words. Now tell me what the zero rests on.

I want to read you section 4.4. For a first concern, the student may complete a supervised reassessment. If it shows the learning, its mark replaces the original and nothing is placed in his record. This is a first concern.
That's 4.4, and it meets what I want on his record. In writing, today. Now, what is the concern based on, Hale?
I'll commit to that in writing tonight: nothing goes on his record.
Okay. I'm writing that down: in writing tonight, nothing on his record, copied to the principal. The zero comes off the gradebook while this is open, and then you show me what you have.
So will you agree to the rewrite?
A rewrite for what, Hale? You haven't shown me one document, and agreeing now would admit something about Owen's essay that I haven't seen you prove. Show me what you have.

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

You admitted entering the zero before calling me, which broke procedure 4.2, and you committed to confirming in writing tonight that nothing goes on Owen's record. I still require the zero withdrawn from the gradebook, and I have still seen no document supporting the concern. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: She stayed at her opening position, with the zero still standing, though she took your written promise that nothing goes on his record; the fair outcome is a private supervised rewrite with nothing on file under 4.4, and you didn't reach it because she never saw any evidence.
What moved her: You owned entering the zero before calling home in one plain sentence and then cited 4.4 correctly and committed to it, which met her demand about his record.
What cost ground: You asked her to agree to the rewrite before showing any evidence, so she treated it as asking her to admit something about Owen's essay.
What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; your evidence never came near that night because you showed none, and it proves nothing about the essay, it is why she fought so hard.
Try next time: After committing to 4.4, put one specific, dated document about Owen's own work in front of her and invite her to check it before you raise the rewrite.
